about.title: Welcome to Lunaavo — Making Everyday Living Better
about.intro: At Lunaavo, we believe a well-equipped kitchen can make everyday life easier, more enjoyable, and more inspiring.
about.body: Whether you're preparing your morning coffee, cooking a family dinner, upgrading your kitchen appliances, or exploring new ways to prepare your favorite meals, having the right equipment makes a difference.

sections.title: Who We Are
paragraphs: Lunaavo is a U.S.-based online retail store operated by San Rafael Luggage Center, Inc, with its business address in Berkeley, California.
We focus on kitchen and dining products designed for a variety of household needs, cooking preferences, and lifestyles.

We understand that choosing kitchen equipment is about more than selecting a product. It's about finding something that fits your space, suits your cooking habits, and provides the functionality you're looking for.
Our online store is organized to make exploring different products and comparing options more convenient.

sections.title: What You'll Find at Lunaavo
paragraphs: Our Kitchen & Dining collection brings together products for everyday food preparation, cooking, beverage making, and kitchen organization.
Coffee & Beverage Essentials
Start your day with equipment suited to your favorite drinks.
Explore options for preparing coffee, espresso, tea, and other beverages, with different features and capacities to suit individual preferences.
Cooking & Food Preparation
From preparing ingredients to cooking complete meals, the right kitchen equipment can simplify everyday tasks.
Our product selection includes cooking and food preparation appliances for a range of needs, from routine meals to more specialized recipes.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)
faq.intro: Shopping for kitchen appliances and dining essentials should be simple, convenient, and stress-free.

items.question: What is Lunaavo?
items.answer: Lunaavo is a U.S.-based online store specializing in kitchen and dining products. We bring together kitchen appliances, cooking equipment, food preparation essentials, and related products to help customers find equipment suited to their homes and everyday routines. Our goal is to make shopping for kitchen and dining essentials straightforward, informative, and convenient. Visit our store: https://lunaavo.us

items.question: Is Lunaavo a legitimate U.S. business?
items.answer: Lunaavo is operated by San Rafael Luggage Center, Inc, with its business address in Berkeley, California. We provide our business information, contact details, and customer service policies so shoppers can identify the company operating our website and contact us when assistance is needed. Legal Business Name: San Rafael Luggage Center, Inc Business Address: 2221 Shattuck Ave., Berkeley, CA 94704, United States Customer Support: info@lunaavo.us

items.question: Where is Lunaavo located?
items.answer: Our listed business address is: Lunaavo — San Rafael Luggage Center, Inc 2221 Shattuck Ave. Berkeley, CA 94704 United States Lunaavo operates as an online shopping destination. Please contact us before arranging an in-person visit, as the business address does not necessarily serve as a public showroom or customer pickup location.

items.question: What products does Lunaavo sell?
items.answer: Lunaavo focuses on kitchen and dining essentials, including products for cooking, beverage preparation, food processing, and other kitchen activities. Depending on current product availability, you can explore kitchen appliances and specialized equipment for different household needs. Browse our website to see our current selection.

items.question: Are your products brand-new and unused?
items.answer: Product condition should be clearly identified in the individual product listing. If a product is described as new, it should match that description. Any applicable condition details, included accessories, and product-specific limitations should be reviewed before purchase. If you would like confirmation about a particular item, contact us with the product name or link before ordering.

items.question: Why are some products priced lower than elsewhere?
items.answer: Product prices can vary between retailers because of supplier pricing, inventory costs, promotions, and market conditions. A lower price does not automatically mean a product is used or defective. We recommend comparing the exact model number, product specifications, condition, included accessories, and warranty information when evaluating offers. If you have questions about a particular product or price, our support team can help clarify the listing information.

items.question: How do I know which appliance is right for my kitchen?
items.answer: We recommend reviewing the product's specifications carefully, particularly: * Dimensions and available installation space. * Capacity and performance features. * Electrical or gas requirements. * Product model number. * Included accessories. * Compatibility and installation instructions. * Manufacturer recommendations. For larger appliances, verify measurements and utility requirements before ordering. If you need clarification, send our team the product link and your question.

items.question: Are the products shown on your website available to order?
items.answer: Product availability is indicated on individual listings where supported by our website. Inventory may change, particularly for popular models or promotional products. If an item is unavailable, you may be unable to purchase it until availability is updated. For questions about a specific item, please contact our customer support team.

items.question: Do your appliances come with accessories?
items.answer: Included accessories vary by product and model. Please check the product description and manufacturer's specifications to understand what is included. Accessories shown in lifestyle photographs may not always be included unless explicitly stated in the listing. If you're unsure, contact us before purchasing.

items.question: Do you sell replacement parts or accessories?
items.answer: Available replacement parts and accessories depend on our current catalog. You can search our website for the product or accessory you're looking for. If you need help identifying a compatible item, please provide the appliance model number and relevant details.

items.question: How do I place an order?
items.answer: Ordering from Lunaavo is straightforward:

groups.title: 3. Review the description, specifications, and price.
4. Add the item to your cart.
6. Enter your billing and shipping information.
8. Review your order and submit it.

items.question: Can I place an order without creating an account?
items.answer: If guest checkout is enabled on our website, you can complete your purchase without creating an account. Available checkout options are displayed during the ordering process. Please enter a valid email address so you can receive important order communications.

items.question: How do I know if my order was successful?
items.answer: After successfully submitting your order, you should see an order confirmation or order status message. You may also receive a confirmation email containing your order details. If you don't receive an email, check your spam or junk folder. If you're still unsure whether your order was received, contact info@lunaavo.us before attempting another purchase to avoid duplicate orders.

items.question: Can I modify my order after placing it?
items.answer: If you need to change an order, contact our support team as soon as possible. Depending on the order's processing and fulfillment status, certain changes may no longer be possible. Please include your order number and the details you want to update. We will review your request and explain the available options.

items.question: Can I cancel my order?
items.answer: You may request an order cancellation by contacting customer support. Whether cancellation is possible depends on the order's current status and the terms of our Order Cancellation Policy. Orders that have already entered shipping or fulfillment may be subject to different procedures. For the fastest assistance, contact us immediately with your order number. Read more: Order Cancellation Policy

items.question: What payment methods do you accept?
items.answer: The payment methods currently available are displayed during checkout. Available options may depend on your order, payment provider, and other applicable conditions. Please review the checkout page for the payment methods supported for your purchase. If you experience a payment issue, contact our customer support team.

items.question: Is it safe to make a payment on Lunaavo?
items.answer: We aim to provide a secure and responsible online shopping experience. Payments are handled through the payment services integrated with our checkout, subject to their applicable security practices. For your protection, never send complete payment card details, passwords, or security codes through email or live chat. You can review our Privacy Policy for more information about how customer information is handled.

items.question: Why was my payment declined?
items.answer: A payment may be declined for several reasons, including: * Incorrect card details. * Insufficient available funds. * Bank security restrictions. * Billing information mismatches. * Payment provider verification requirements. * Temporary processing errors. We recommend checking your payment details and contacting your bank or payment provider if the issue continues. If you need additional assistance, our team can help review the checkout issue without requesting sensitive card information.

items.question: Are there additional charges at checkout?
items.answer: The total amount payable should be displayed before you complete your order. Depending on your purchase and delivery location, the final amount may include applicable taxes, shipping charges, or other disclosed fees. Please review your order summary carefully before submitting payment.

items.question: Do you offer discount codes or promotional offers?
items.answer: Promotional offers may be available from time to time. When a valid discount code is offered, you can enter it in the applicable field during checkout. Discounts may have eligibility requirements, expiration dates, or other conditions. Only promotions published or confirmed through Lunaavo's official channels should be treated as authorized offers.

items.question: Where does Lunaavo ship?
items.answer: Lunaavo serves customers in the United States. Shipping eligibility for a particular product or destination is determined by the options available during checkout and our published Shipping & Delivery Policy. Some products may have delivery restrictions due to their size, weight, or handling requirements.

items.question: How much does shipping cost?
items.answer: Applicable shipping charges, if any, are determined by the product, order, destination, and available delivery method. Any shipping fees should be disclosed during checkout before you submit your order. For further information, please review our Shipping & Delivery Policy.

items.question: How long does delivery take?
items.answer: Estimated delivery times depend on factors such as: * Product availability. * Order processing. * Shipping destination. * Carrier service. * Product dimensions and handling requirements. * Weather or transportation disruptions. Please refer to the estimated delivery information provided during checkout and in our Shipping & Delivery Policy. Delivery estimates are not guarantees unless expressly stated.

items.question: How can I track my order?
items.answer: If tracking information is available for your shipment, it may be provided through your order updates or shipping confirmation. You can use the tracking details to check your shipment's progress. If you need help locating tracking information, contact our team with your order number. Visit: Track Your Order

items.question: What should I do if my order is delayed?
items.answer: We understand that waiting longer than expected can be frustrating. If your order has not arrived within the communicated delivery timeframe, contact us at info@lunaavo.us. Please include your order number so we can review the available shipment information and assist with the next steps.

items.question: What if my package is marked delivered but I haven't received it?
items.answer: First, check the delivery location, surrounding areas, and any delivery notifications from the carrier. If the package is still missing, contact the carrier and notify Lunaavo customer support. We'll review the available order and tracking details and help you understand the next steps.

items.question: Do large kitchen appliances require special delivery arrangements?
items.answer: Some larger appliances may require specialized shipping, additional handling, or delivery coordination. Depending on the product, delivery services may differ from those available for smaller parcels. Please review the product listing and shipping information for any special requirements. Installation, unpacking, or removal of an existing appliance should not be assumed to be included unless expressly stated.

items.question: Can I return a product if I'm not satisfied?
items.answer: Return eligibility depends on the product, its condition, the reason for the return, and our published Returns & Refunds Policy. Before requesting a return, please review the applicable policy and contact customer support for instructions. Do not ship merchandise to our business address without receiving return instructions.

items.question: What if I receive a damaged, defective, or incorrect item?
items.answer: If there is a problem with your order, please contact us promptly. Include: * Your order number. * The product name. * A description of the issue. * Clear photographs, if relevant. * Any additional details that may help us review the concern. Our team will assess the information and explain the available resolution options under our policies and applicable law.

items.question: How do I request a refund?
items.answer: To request a refund, email info@lunaavo.us with your order number and the reason for your request. Our support team will review your inquiry and provide information about eligibility and the applicable procedure. Approved refunds are processed according to our Returns & Refunds Policy and applicable payment provider requirements. The time required for funds to appear may also depend on your financial institution.

items.question: Can I exchange a product?
items.answer: Exchange availability depends on the product and the circumstances of your request. Please contact customer support with your order details and the item you wish to exchange. We will explain whether an exchange or another available resolution is possible.

items.question: Where should I send a returned item?
items.answer: Please do not send returns directly to our listed business address unless our support team specifically authorizes that location. Contact info@lunaavo.us first to obtain the applicable return instructions. Shipping an item to an unauthorized address may delay the return process.

items.question: Do Lunaavo products come with a warranty?
items.answer: Warranty coverage varies by product and manufacturer. Where applicable, warranty details may be provided in the product listing or accompanying manufacturer documentation. Before purchasing, we recommend reviewing the available warranty terms, including coverage, exclusions, and claim procedures. For additional questions, contact our customer support team.

items.question: What should I do if my appliance stops working?
items.answer: Start by reviewing the product manual and any manufacturer troubleshooting instructions. If the issue continues, contact us with: * Your order number. * Product name and model. * A description of the problem. * Relevant photos or other supporting information. We can help you identify the applicable support or warranty information. For electrical, gas, or other potentially hazardous appliance issues, discontinue use and seek qualified assistance when appropriate.

items.question: Does Lunaavo provide installation services?
items.answer: Installation services are not included unless expressly stated in the product listing or purchase agreement. Certain appliances may require professional installation, including equipment involving electrical wiring, gas connections, plumbing, or ventilation. Always follow the manufacturer's installation requirements and applicable local regulations.

items.question: How is my personal information used?
items.answer: Customer information may be used for purposes such as processing orders, providing support, communicating about purchases, and operating our website. For more details about the categories of information collected, the purposes of processing, and available privacy rights, please review our Privacy Policy.

items.question: What should I do if I'm having trouble using the website?
items.answer: If you're experiencing a technical issue, try refreshing the page or using an updated browser. If the issue persists, contact us with: * A description of the problem. * The page or product involved. * Your device and browser, if relevant. * A screenshot, if helpful. Please avoid sharing passwords or sensitive payment information.

items.question: Can I contact Lunaavo before placing an order?
items.answer: Absolutely. We encourage customers to ask questions before purchasing, particularly when selecting appliances with specific dimensions, compatibility requirements, or technical features. Contact us with the product link and your question, and we'll help clarify the available information.

items.question: How can I contact Lunaavo customer support?
items.answer: You can reach Lunaavo through the following channels: Email: info@lunaavo.us Phone: +1 (510) 345-2632 Business Hours: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM Pacific Time Live Chat: Available 24/7 Website: https://lunaavo.us For order-related inquiries, include your order number to help us locate the relevant information.

items.question: Is customer support available on weekends?
items.answer: Our regular business hours are Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM Pacific Time. Our website's live chat is available 24/7. Inquiries requiring additional review may be handled during regular business hours.

items.question: How can I submit feedback or a complaint?
items.answer: We welcome customer feedback. If you have a suggestion, concern, or complaint, email info@lunaavo.us with a description of the matter.
